vintage: Units of 1 July 2025 with the types of the NSO register of 2026-11-28 (after Resolutions 237/NQ-UBTVQH16 and 388/NQ-UBTVQH16)

rules.source: Vietnamese Provinces Database v5.2.0 (wards GIS from the official reference map sapnhap.bando.com.vn, codes and names from the NSO list), as updated to Resolution 388/NQ-UBTVQH16 of September 2026.
rules.kind: Each unit's code and type (xã, phường, đặc khu) are those of the NSO register in force on 2026-11-28; the build stops if any code, type or name (ignoring tone-mark placement, case and spaces) differs.
rules.changes: A change is a unit whose type in the NSO register of 1 July 2025 differs from its type today. Each is attributed to the resolution for its province, and the build stops unless the number and the names of the changed units match the resolution's text.
rules.province: Each commune's province is the one its official code belongs to, matched to the map's 34 provinces by name.
rules.geometry: Vertices snapped to 1e-5°; borders split where the neighbours change and kept once (arcs); each arc simplified (Douglas–Peucker, 0.12 km) with its ends fixed, so shared borders stay shared. Coordinates are map units × 2, delta-encoded.
rules.area: Computed from the full-resolution outline in the map's equal-area (Albers) projection. It agrees with the source's stated areaKm2 within 5% for about 94% of units. The rest differ because the source's stated area is out of date for some merged units (most Cà Mau communes, e.g. Giá Rai 105 km² outlined vs 11.8 stated; the outlines sum to 7,618 km² for Cà Mau, NSO's area is 7,887), coastal units' official areas include tidal flats the outline leaves out (Gò Công Đông), outlines miss small islets (Vân Đồn, Cô Tô), and the Trường Sa and Hoàng Sa outlines enclose whole reefs and lagoons, not just land (4,226 and 636 km² outlined vs 496 and 350 stated).
rules.names: Names exactly as the source spells them, including its older tone placement (Hoà, Thuỷ, Hoá: about 200 names), which differs from the newer style the provinces use (Hòa); search treats both as equal.
rules.label: Centroid of the commune's largest part; if that falls outside it, the middle of the widest span through the part at the centroid's latitude. If that point lies outside the map's frame (the map less its margin), the label goes to the same point of the largest part whose point is inside the frame (only Đặc khu Trường Sa, whose largest reef outline lies beyond the map's southern edge).

count_note: The file is newer than the June 2025 list: 10 Đồng Nai communes became wards (Resolution 237/NQ-UBTVQH16, from 30 April 2026) and 12 Bắc Ninh communes became wards (Resolution 388/NQ-UBTVQH16, from 20 September 2026). The number of units, 3,321, is unchanged.

outline_check.method: Intersection over union of each 2025 province, rasterised on a 0.005° (~0.55 km) grid, with the map's province lookup raster (OCHA COD-AB 2025 outlines).

stats.basis: Population 2025 and natural area as shown on the official merger map of administrative units (sapnhap.bando.com.vn, Vietnam Natural Resources, Environment and Cartography Publishing House), retrieved 28 November 2026; the province totals are the map's 'Dân số 2025 (người)' column.

fields.area_km2: natural area stated by the source, km² (null: see null_reason)
fields.population: population 2025 stated by the source, people (null: see null_reason)
fields.res: index into resolutions: the resolution the source cites for the unit
fields.null_reason: code into reasons, present when any of the three is null
fields.a: outline area computed from the boundary, km² (a different basis; always present)

rules.stats: Natural area (km²) and population 2025 (people) are the figures shown for each unit on the official merger map of administrative units (sapnhap.bando.com.vn, Vietnam Natural Resources, Environment and Cartography Publishing House, Ministry of Agriculture and Environment), retrieved 28 November 2026; the map labels its population 'Dân số 2025'. The 34 resolutions of 16 June 2025 themselves list no figures. Units that became wards in 2026 (Resolutions 237 and 388/NQ-UBTVQH16) kept their area and population.
rules.match: Each record is matched to a unit by its official code; the source still has an old code for two units (listed in matched_by_name), matched by province and name instead.
rules.copy: When several units carry exactly the same area and population, the figures are kept only for the unit whose outline area is within 5% of the stated area, if no other is within 10%.
rules.area: area_km2 is the stated area, shown only if it is within 1.5× of the outline area (field a, computed from the boundary); otherwise area and population are null with a reason.
rules.population: population is null when missing, equal to a province total, or under 0.3× the WorldPop 2025 estimate summed over the unit's outline (WorldPop is used only for this check, never as a value; the build lists any unit between 0.2× and 0.42×, and there is none). Values above the estimate are kept: WorldPop misses most people on small islands.
rules.density: density = population / area_km2 (people per km²), only when both are shown.
rules.sums: Per province: ratio = the populations shown / the province's 'Dân số 2025' in the map's own province table; worldpop_share = the units shown's share of the province's WorldPop people. The build stops unless ratio / worldpop_share is within 20% of 1. source_sum_ratio compares the sum over all units in the source (checked or not) with the province total.

reasons.copy: The source gives this unit exactly the same area and population as another unit; the figures fit the other unit's outline, so none are shown here.
reasons.no_area: The source gives no area (0) for this unit.
reasons.reef: Archipelago special zone: its outline takes in reefs and lagoons, so the stated area cannot be checked against it.
reasons.area_mismatch: The stated area is more than 1.5 times off the unit's outline (for most Cà Mau units, the area of one pre-merger commune: the source's Cà Mau communes add up to 76% of its province total), so the record does not describe this unit; its population is withheld too.
reasons.pending: The source shows no population for this unit.
reasons.province_total: The stated population equals a whole province's population in the same source.
reasons.implausible: The stated population is under 0.3 times the WorldPop 2025 estimate for the unit's outline (apparently a digit dropped); it is not corrected.

resolutions.id: Nghị quyết số 1662/NQ-UBTVQH15, Nghị quyết số 30/2026/QH16
